mission: Energy-native monetary protocol with verifiable issuance, redemption, and solvency controls.

functional_spec.token_issuance: Mint only from verified surplus energy under oracle freshness and reserve safety constraints.
functional_spec.redemption: Burn token into energy-linked claim path for intrinsic floor behavior.
functional_spec.stability: Maintain peg corridor with PI-like control and stress-aware safeguards.
functional_spec.risk_layer: Support margin, liquidation, and settlement through option series infrastructure.
functional_spec.governance: Constrain privileged actions through role-based access and pause controls.

next_steps: Harden live oracle attestation and meter-proof ingestion for production trust.
Pilot with constrained participant set before broader currency framing.
